messages:
cs-tilly: Heads up — multiple paying customers reporting 401s and "invalid_token" starting ~09:03 UTC. A bunch of high-priority tickets opened and customers are escalating. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: deploy auth-service v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 completed at 09:01 UTC. Feature flag key_rotation_v2 set true during rolling deploy.

ops-evan: Observed auth 401 spike at 09:02. Quick tail of auth logs: 
```
09:02:41 auth-svc: lookup_key failed: unknown key_id k-2026-03-15-ab12
09:02:42 auth-svc: introspect error: downstream KMS 500
09:02:45 proxy: returned 401 to client for api_key xxxx-xxxx
```
Seems like new key IDs weren't resolvable by the index. Redis misses for key_index jumped at the same time.

sre-jen: Confirming — redis key hit-rate for key_index:v2 dropped from 99% -> 21% at 09:02:30. Replica lag for secret-sync -> redis shows ~28s lag on redis-replica-2. Index builder job started at 09:01:50, probably still warming.

frank: Oncall runtime here. I'm going to pause the rotation flag to stop flipping active keys. Prefer feature-flag toggle instead of full rollback.

leela: +1. Also trigger a rebuild/sync for key_index:v2 from KMS and block rotation until checksum matches primary.

cs-tilly: Customers want ETA. Can we get an estimate for remediation?

frank: If flag toggle works we can expect normalization within ~10m. I'll flip the flag now.

frank: Executing toggle: 
```
curl -X POST https://flags.prod.internal/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS" -d '{"key_rotation_v2":false}'
```

infra-bot: Feature flag update accepted and propagating to 10 regions (started 09:07 UTC).

ops-evan: After toggle, 401 error rate dropped ~90% within 45s. auth.401.rate peaked 1.2k rps -> ~100 rps. Some customers still on retry loops, might need client-side backoff.

maya: Support update sent to affected customers: "We've rolled back a recent key rotation change and are monitoring. Please share request IDs for any persistent failures." Also sent workaround for customers who can rotate API keys from the dashboard. A few large accounts can't rotate automatically.

sre-jen: Root-cause hypothesis: rotation feature flipped while key_index:v2 was partially built. Because of redis replica lag the index was incomplete in some regions; rotation made new keys primary and tokens referencing old/new key IDs failed lookup, causing invalid_token/insufficient_scope errors. Two issues: no preflip warmness check and global flag flip instead of staged canary.

frank: Opening emergency PR to add preflip check: ensure key_index:v2 warmness >= 95% and checksum match across replicas before allowing rotation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/3320

frank: Also adding a release pipeline step: staged flag propagation with canary region and health probe for key lookups. Plan to ship tomorrow after review.

ops-evan: Rollback/flag rollback completed across all regions by 09:09. No further big spikes after 09:10. Marking incident mitigated for now.

customer-bot: Status update posted at 09:12 UTC: "Authentication errors causing 401s were resolved after reverting a recent key rotation change. Investigating root cause; follow-up update to come."

leela: Action items: 
- frank: land PR #3320 + add warmness/checksum gate (ETA 24h)
- infra: add alert for secret-sync replication lag > 10s (ETA 48h)
- cs-tilly: personalized follow-ups to top affected customers w/ timeline and mitigation (ETA 2h)
- sre-jen: draft postmortem + attach logs/graphs (ETA 8h)

maya: A couple of customers asked for credits. I'll coordinate with finance/sales for churn prevention credits.

cs-tilly: Thanks team — please paste postmortem link here when ready and tag tickets with auth-rotation-2026-03-15.

frank: One follow-up: add a short TTL-based fallback in auth-service that refuses rotation flips if index warmness < 90% to prevent accidental global flips. Adding to PR.

sre-jen: Scheduling postmortem review today at 16:00 UTC. We'll include timeline, metrics, and the PR diffs.

ops-evan: Leaving channel but keeping incident in tracking. Will update on ticket statuses.

cs-tilly: Closing channel thread for now. Re-open if customers report new failures. Excellent quick response everyone :heart:
